cadenas.en_por_celda: Pest control, hygiene & lab tests — contracted

cadenas.es: Cadencia
Control de plagas (DDD) por empresa autorizada: visita, parte firmado y certificado en vigor
cadenas.en_por_celda: Pest control by a licensed operator: service visit and signed service report on file (write the report # in the Notes column)

cadenas.es: Trimestral
Limpieza de los conductos de extracción del obrador por empresa homologada, con certificado
cadenas.en_por_celda: Exhaust and ventilation: filters and fans cleaned as the manufacturer says; if you cook with grease under a hood (NFPA 96), hood and duct cleaning by a certified contractor at its frequency for your volume

cadenas.es: Anual
Analítica de superficies, de producto y del agua de la red interior en laboratorio externo (legionela sólo si tienes torre de refrigeración o acumulador de agua caliente)
cadenas.en_por_celda: Lab tests by an outside lab: water activity and pH of each new ganache or filling BEFORE it goes on sale, and again if the recipe changes, to set its shelf life and confirm whether it is TCS (FDA Food Code 1-201.10); water testing only if you are on a private well

cadenas.es: Semestral
Renovar los carnés de manipulador de alimentos del equipo y archivar los certificados
cadenas.en_por_celda: Food handler cards where your state or county requires them (renewals on its schedule) and a certified food protection manager on the team (FDA Food Code 2-102.12)

cadenas.es: Revisión de cámaras y neveras por frigorista: gas, estanqueidad, juntas y ciclo de desescarche
cadenas.en_por_celda: Refrigeration service by an EPA 608-certified tech: cool room, fridges and display cases — coils, gaskets, refrigerant leak check and defrost cycle

cadenas.es: Revisión de extintores y BIE por empresa mantenedora (etiqueta y acta)
cadenas.en_por_celda: Annual extinguisher maintenance by a licensed fire protection company: new tag and record (OSHA 1910.157); hydrostatic tests as the label says (OSHA 1910.157(f))

cadenas.es: Revisión de la instalación de gas por empresa habilitada, si el obrador la tiene
cadenas.en_por_celda: Gas lines and appliance connections checked by a licensed pro, if you have gas, as often as your local code or gas utility requires

cadenas.es: Cada 5 años
Revisar la póliza de responsabilidad civil y de continuidad de negocio: sumas aseguradas y actividades excluidas
cadenas.en_por_celda: Renew insurance and review coverage: general and product liability, property, workers' comp, business interruption and equipment breakdown with spoilage (a cool room down in July can melt the stock)

cadenas.es: Comprobar que el registro sanitario (RGSEAA) recoge la actividad y las instalaciones reales, obrador incluido
cadenas.en_por_celda: Check that your health permit (and, if your state requires one to make candy or to sell wholesale or by mail, your food manufacturing license) is current and matches what you really do: kitchen, shop, shipping

cadenas.es: Revisión del TPV y del software de facturación (requisitos antifraude / Verifactu)
cadenas.en_por_celda: POS check before year-end: software updates, sales tax rates and settings (many states tax candy even where groceries are exempt), user permissions
